theme_details.name: AXIOM - MONARCH SYSTEM
theme_details.first_impression: THIS IS NOT A NORMAL PRODUCTIVITY APP. Cinematic game HUD, premium 3D command center, holographic OS.

h1_rank_boss.description: Used for massive impact: Player Rank (SSS), Boss Names, Level up overlays.

headings_ui.description: Used for standard section titles, panel headers, and primary UI navigation.

body_stats_logs.description: Used for all system data, stats (STR, AGI), XP numbers, system logs, and dense text.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Tactical Minimalism and HUD Precision. High density grids for command center, generous spacing for cinematic moments.
spacing_and_layout.container_styles: Use strict grid alignments. Top-level frames should have thin glowing borders with corner brackets.
spacing_and_layout.corner_treatments: Avoid soft rounded corners. Use sharp edges or CSS clip-path (clip-path: polygon(10px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 10px), calc(100% - 10px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 10px)) for a tech/gaming aesthetic.

hud_panels.appearance: Translucent dark plates suspended over a grid void.
hud_panels.enhancements: Add L-shaped SVG corner brackets at top-left and bottom-right to simulate a targeting reticle frame. Use 1px inner box-shadow for depth.

quest_cards.styles: bg-black/40 border-l-2 border-l-[#00F0FF] border-t border-r border-b border-[#00F0FF]/10 p-4 transition-all duration-300
quest_cards.completion_flow: When clicked to complete, flash white, emit cyan glow, then dissolve or shrink.

boss_cards.appearance: Massive, menacing threat targets (e.g., THE PROCRASTINATOR).
boss_cards.styles: bg-gradient-to-t from-[#FF2A2A]/20 to-black/80 border border-[#FF2A2A]/30 p-6 relative overflow-hidden
boss_cards.enhancements: Include abstract red warning scanlines. Text should glow crimson.

xp_bars.structure: Instead of a single continuous bar, break it into 10-20 small segments for a mechanical instrument feel.

rank_emblems.styles: text-[#00F0FF] font-michroma text-4xl text-shadow-[0_0_15px_#00F0FF] border border-[#00F0FF]/40 rotate-45 p-4 flex items-center justify-center

cinematic_overlays.appearance: Full screen event interruptions (Rank up, Boss Detected).
cinematic_overlays.styles: fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-sm flex flex-col items-center justify-center pointer-events-none
cinematic_overlays.animation: Flash white -> Reveal massive Michroma text -> Scanline glitch -> Fade out.

motion.ambient: Slow, purposeful motion. A rotating SVG reticle (20s duration), a pulsing status dot (pulse opacity 50% to 100%), or a slow scanning line moving down the panel.
motion.interactions: Crisp and immediate. No 'springy' bounces. Use ease-out for 150-200ms.
motion.cinematic_events: Scale-in from 0.8 to 1.0 with intense glow blooms and slight chromatic aberration (via text-shadow offsets).

3d_and_creative.usage_context: Command Center background and AXIOM Architect AI representation.
3d_and_creative.scene_setup: Render a dark void with floating geometric nodes or a central 'Core' sphere. Use an InstancedMesh for background star/data-particle fields.
3d_and_creative.material: Holographic material with fresnel glow and scanlines. Primary mesh color: #00F0FF, Background color: transparent/black.
3d_and_creative.performance: Keep geometry simple (Icosahedron or Sphere). Avoid heavy textures. Use post-processing (Bloom) sparingly to maintain 60FPS.

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 1.5 for a sharp, technical appearance. No filled icons. Pair with cyan or silver colors.
icons.forbidden: Do NOT use emoji icons under any circumstances. Everything must feel like a precision instrument.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure JetBrains Mono data points have at least 4.5:1 against the dark background.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Provide a strict toggle for users. Wrap ambient R3F rotation and CSS pulses in a prefers-reduced-motion check.
accessibility.test_ids: CRITICAL: All interactive elements, buttons, and stat values MUST include data-testid. E.g., data-testid='quest-complete-button', data-testid='player-str-stat'.

image_urls.description: Abstract holographic lines on a sphere. Use as a fallback for the 3D Architect core if R3F fails or as a hero background element.
Dark abstract waves. Can be used with opacity 5% as a background texture for Boss cards.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize React app with Tailwind, Shadcn, Lucide-react, React Three Fiber (@react-three/fiber @react-three/drei), and Framer Motion.
Do NOT use Vercel/Stripe 'soft SaaS' aesthetics. Implement sharp cuts, glassmorphism, and neon glows.
Create a layout shell `AxiomShell` containing the top/side navigation and the 3D R3F Canvas strictly in the background.
Implement the 6 deep screens required: Command Center, Daily Operations, Quest Board, Player Evolution, Boss Archive, AXIOM Architect AI.
In Command Center, ensure the Player HUD uses absolute or fixed positioning overlaying the 3D scene.
Fonts MUST be imported in the HTML/CSS entry point.
Quest complete and Level Up actions must trigger a centralized overlay component that handles the cinematic flash and text reveal.
Ensure the AXIOM Architect AI chat uses the JetBrains Mono font for responses to feel like terminal readouts.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. AXIOM is a high-end sci-fi OS.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
MUST NOT center align the app container. Text alignment should be left-aligned for data readability unless specifically framing a cinematic title.
Always use sharp-edged or cut-corner buttons with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Always include data-testid attributes for testing.
